name: Milestone MHT-P80E
notes: Verified on paper: 48/24/16/12 columns at 1-4x on 80mm; 60mm rolls print 384 dots.
Built-in text sizes above 4x are clamped by the firmware. Use a `big` block for anything larger.
The ~7.5mm blank at the leading edge of every label is mechanical (the cutter sits past the print head).
